# Ledgerwood Lash Atelier

> A two-chair lash and brow studio for people who want the work to be invisible. No packages, no upsells, no music you have to talk over.

lash and brow studio in Providence, RI. By appointment only. Hours: Tue – Sat · 9:30 AM–6:30 PM.

## Services
- Classic Full Set — from $180: One extension per natural lash, mapped to your own lash line. The set people do not notice you are wearing.
- Volume Full Set — from $225: Hand-made fans for density without weight. Built lighter than it looks.
- Fill — from $85: Replaces grown-out extensions and rebalances the map. Book within three weeks of your last visit.
- Removal — from $40: Gel-based removal that leaves the natural lash intact. Free within seven days of a set we placed.
- Brow Lamination — from $95: Restructures the brow hair to sit where it grows best, then shapes to it. Lasts six to eight weeks.
- Brow Tint and Shape — from $65: Colour matched half a shade under your hair, then shaped with wax and tweezers.
